title: Marvin Mims bruised his foot, Broncos think he'll be fine

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Marvin Mims bruised his foot, Broncos think he'll be fine
sources.description: The last thing any team wants to see is a significant contributor get hurt in the final week of the preseason, so it wasn't a great development for the Broncos when wide receiver Marvin Mims went to the medical tent early in Thursday's game.
